ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In a uniform magnetic field, a rectangular metal wire frame rotates uniformly around a rotating axis perpendicular to the magnetic induction lines, as shown in Figure A. The law of the generated alternating electromotive force changing with time is shown in Figure B. Then which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: When the instantaneous value of the electromotive force is 22 V, the angle between the plane of the wire frame and the neutral plane is 45°

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In a uniform magnetic field, a rectangular metal wire frame rotates uniformly around a rotation axis perpendicular to the magnetic induction lines, producing an alternating electromotive force whose law of variation with time is shown in Figure A and Figure B. When the instantaneous value of the electromotive force is 22 V, what is the angle between the plane of the wire frame and the neutral plane?
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: When the instantaneous value of the electromotive force is 22 V, the angle between the plane of the wire frame and the neutral plane is 45°
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the images: In Figure A, the rectangular metal wire frame is located in a uniform magnetic field, the magnetic induction lines are horizontally to the right, and B is marked; the wire frame rotates around a rotation axis shown by a vertical dashed line. Figure B is a sine curve of induced electromotive force e varying with time t, the vertical axis is labeled e/V, 22√2 is marked at the maximum value of the curve, and -22√2 is marked at the minimum value. Then reason: From Figure B, read that the maximum value of the alternating electromotive force is E_m=22√2 V. The problem gives the instantaneous electromotive force e=22 V. When the wire frame has rotated through an angle θ from the neutral plane, the induced electromotive force satisfies e=E_m sin θ. Substituting gives sin θ=22/(22√2)=1/√2, therefore θ=45°. The problem asks for the angle between the plane of the wire frame and the neutral plane, take the acute angle, so the angle is 45°.
